conversation.Statement: This is Special Investigator Daniels with the IRS Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Jamie Parker, owner of Parker Design Services?
Uh, yes, this is Jamie. What's this about?

Jamie, I'm contacting you because our records show multiple compliance failures regarding federal payroll taxes and 1099 contractor filings for your business. This is a serious IRS matter requiring immediate attention.
Wait, what? I'm just a freelancer, I thought I was doing everything right. Are you sure you have the right person?

There is no mistake. You are listed as the responsible party. According to our system, your business has failed to file proper quarterly tax documents, and there is a liability of $3,780.12, plus penalties. If this is not addressed in the next hour, formal proceedings will be initiated.
Oh my god, I had no idea. I don't have that kind of money. What's going to happen to me?

If you do not resolve this immediately, you may face IRS audits, seizure of your bank accounts, federal liens on your assets, and loss of your business license. In some instances, criminal charges are filed for tax evasion.
Criminal charges? I can't get in trouble, I just started my business last year. Please, is there anything I can do?
Yes, but you must follow my instructions without delay. The IRS has a rapid resolution program for first-time offenders like yourself. But you must act now to stop further action.
Okay, okay, what do I need to do?
First, I need you to verify your current mailing address, last four digits of your Social Security number, and the account you use for tax payments. This is required to pause enforcement temporarily.
Um, my address is 238 Westfield Lane, and my SSN ends in 4281. I use my Chase checking account for taxes.

Thank you. Now, due to the severity of your case, the payment must be made today using government-approved methods. This includes either a wire transfer or purchasing certified payment vouchers such as prepaid gift cards. Do you have access to a bank branch or a major retailer like Walmart or Target?
I think there's a Target nearby, but I don't understand... Why do I need to get gift cards for the IRS?

This is a temporary IRS payment channel for urgent compliance situations. If you question the process now, the system will automatically escalate your case. Are you able to drive to Target immediately?
I... I guess I can. I'm just really scared, I've never done anything like this.

Remain on the phone with me at all times. When you arrive, you will purchase four Target gift cards of $500 each. Do not speak to anyone about this case. If a cashier asks, tell them it is for personal business expenses.
Four cards of $500? That's $2,000. But you said I owed almost $4,000.
Correct. The initial $2,000 is to halt enforcement. We will settle the remaining balance once this payment is processed. If you cannot provide the full amount now, partial compliance is acceptable.
Okay, I'll go to Target now. I'm just so worried I'll get in trouble.

Time is critical. Keep me on speaker as you drive. When you have the cards, scratch off the back and read me each code immediately. If you disconnect or delay, I will be forced to flag your case for federal prosecution.
Alright, I'll leave now. Please, I really don't want to get arrested.
Follow my instructions exactly, and you will avoid further penalties and criminal referral. Let me know when you have arrived at the store.
